title: An open subscheme of a Noetherian scheme is Noetherian
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $V\subseteq X$ be an open subset, regarded as the open subscheme $(V,\mathcal O_X|_V)$. Then $V$ is a Noetherian scheme: it is locally Noetherian and its underlying topological space is quasi-compact.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01OW (label lemma-locally-Noetherian, properties.tex line 436, last sentence: every open subscheme of a locally Noetherian scheme is locally Noetherian); Properties, Lemma 01OZ (lemma-Noetherian-topology, line 496: a Noetherian scheme has a Noetherian underlying space); Topology, Lemma 0052 (lemma-Noetherian (1): a subspace of a Noetherian space is Noetherian) and Lemma 04ZA (lemma-Noetherian-quasi-compact (1): a Noetherian space is quasi-compact). Used in Cohomology of Schemes 01YD, proof ('Note that $X\setminus Z'$ is a Noetherian scheme'). Tags verified in literature/stacks-project/tags/tags.
